# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.5 Module 19.5-B: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_gem2_kernel_yearly) (oe_gem2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v195_sco_ara.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# O(1) zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration.
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_gem2_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_gem2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_gem2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem2_ran_y value = current_year }
		oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_events = yes
		oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_events = yes
	}
}

# O(1) host lookup for Kingdom of Scotland historical event arc (oe_gem2.1 .. oe_gem2.8).
oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_events = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:SCO c:SCO = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:SCO = { oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:GBR c:GBR = { is_rebel_country = no has_or_had_tag = SCO } }
		c:GBR = { oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:SBL c:SBL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:SBL = { oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:LOI c:LOI = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:LOI = { oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_chain = yes }
	}
}

# O(1) host lookup for Crown of Aragon historical event arc (oe_gem2.9 .. oe_gem2.16).
oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_events = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ARA c:ARA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:ARA = { oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no has_or_had_tag = ARA } }
		c:SPA = { oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CAT c:CAT = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:CAT = { oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:VAL c:VAL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:VAL = { oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_chain = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MLL c:MLL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		c:MLL = { oe_gem2_dispatch_ara_chain = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Historical Scotland event chain (oe_gem2.1 .. oe_gem2.8, max 1 per year).
oe_gem2_dispatch_sco_chain = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1341
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_gem2_ev_1_done }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem2_ev_1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_gem2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1371
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_gem2_ev_2_done }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem2_ev_2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_gem2.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1411
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_gem2_ev_3_done }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem2_ev_3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_gem2.3
	}
